name: Tangerhütte (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Tangerhütte (a red eagle on white beside crossed hammers and plants).
history: The flag was approved on 20 July 1999 by the Regierungspräsidium Magdeburg; it is red and white striped 1:1.

features.role: Tangerhütte arms — eagle, hammers and plants
